name: privacy-at-a-glance
title: Privacy at a glance
description: Your data practices on one screen: what you collect, why, how long you keep it and who gets it, plus how to use each right.
docs: Every card carries the same four lines, so people can compare kinds of data. Each right links to where it is used, such as a settings page or a form. Pass icons from the icons item as nodes. policyHref is required: the summary always points to the full policy and never replaces it. Pass labels to translate the four line labels and the footer. The rights row takes its columns from how many rights there are and from the width of its column, so no row ends on a tile of its own.
